post_operation: assign non-zero error code to return variable before goto cleanup
critical_variable: err (the int error-return variable returned at function exit)
path_conditions: early-exit path where the return value of platform_get_drvdata is checked for NULL and a goto-cleanup branch is taken without first assigning a negative error code to the err variable; the function then returns err (== 0) at the out: label, masking the failure
